regime_context: Canada/TSX shows Oil & Gas Producers as the clear narrative leader (rank 1, score 1.61, eligible, crowded) with Gold Miners the challenger. The macro backdrop is coincident and thin (n=1, 100% unscheduled surprises), the absolute-trend gate has historically helped this market, and breadth of eligibility is broad (8/16), so this is a multi-theme regime, not a one-narrative squeeze.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Big Banks' improving eligibility and trend-tagged durability (0.59, hurst trend) draws flow from the crowded Oil & Gas leadership; the condition that would retire this watch is a confirmed two-week stretch where Big Banks' score moves above 0.8 while Oil & Gas drops out of the top rank.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The dominant eligible theme with strong breadth (0.786) and the highest durability bar (0.68). Momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha, but the absolute-trend gate (the one validated edge) is active here, and I judge the breadth as genuinely supportive rather than a thin leader. Crowding (~1.04z) is a size-down caution only; I do not fade it.
theses.dissent: The theme is crowded and broad rallies in energy are typically late-cycle; with 100% of recent macro input being unscheduled surprises, headline risk cuts both ways and could hit the most-owned theme hardest.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX benchmark by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Challenger theme, eligible, second-highest score with a rotation margin of only 0.502 behind the leader. Durability is moderate (0.48) and breadth is weak (0.267), so this is a narrower leadership; I lean with it only as a secondary, not a bet on handoff. Not crowded.
evidence: challenger in rotation, margin 0.502 vs leader
theses.dissent: Breadth below 0.3 means the theme is carried by a small subset of names; a single large-cap disappointment could collapse the score without a broad sector decline.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO loses momentum and drops below the S&P/TSX benchmark by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Pipelines & Midstream
theses.thesis: Eligible energy-adjacent theme with high durability (0.68) and trend-shaped Hurst tag; scores are low (0.14) but the absolute-trend gate is the validated risk-control leg and it is not crowded. Not scorable, so I keep conviction low.
theses.dissent: Unscorable, so the call is ungraded; low score means it may simply lag the broader energy complex for the horizon despite trend health.
